# Psalm 104 – Wonder at God’s Works (Psalm 104:24)

## Emotional Focus
Quiet thankfulness for how God cares for the whole world.

## Key KJV
“O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.” (Psalm 104:24)

## Gentle Retelling
The psalmist looked around at mountains, rivers, and trees and said, “Lord, You made everything with wisdom!” The whole earth is full of God’s riches.

## Coloring Prompt
Peaceful landscape with mountains, river, trees, and soft sunlight.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Everything around us shows how wise and good God is.”
